visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with straight black hair and bangs, wearing a brown t-shirt, sits at a wooden table in a modern kitchen. She holds a piece of cooked squid and speaks to the camera. A large stainless steel refrigerator stands in the background. (2) A young man with glasses and short black hair, wearing a black graphic t-shirt, stands in a living room with white walls and a glass-paneled door. He addresses the camera directly with expressive facial movements. (3) The man sits at a kitchen counter with a Starbucks paper bag and a plastic cup. He opens the bag to reveal a chicken salad bowl with broccoli and tomatoes. (4) A woman and the young girl are seen through a window, looking at a waterfall in the distance during a rainy day. The woman holds a piece of food. (5) Close-up of the man eating the salad bowl with a black plastic fork, focusing on him chewing broccoli with a focused expression. (6) In the kitchen, the man holds a tray of fresh squid. He then stands with the young girl; he is wearing a beige t-shirt. They begin preparing food on a wooden cutting board. (7) The girl helps cut green onions with the man's guidance. They move to the sink to wash the large squid under running water, and the man pulls out a transparent internal bone. (8) The girl peels purple garlic cloves into a small white bowl on the kitchen counter. (9) The man and girl stand by a gas stove. He pours olive oil into a white ceramic pot, followed by chopped shallots and onions. He adds the squid pieces, rice wine, and water. (10) The man uses tongs to transfer the cooked squid to a bowl. He adds konjac noodles to the boiling pot, then picks up the girl and carries her away from the kitchen. (11) The man returns to the stove, adds the squid back into the pot with celery and white pepper. The camera shows a close-up of the bubbling soup. (12) The man, wearing blue oven mitts, places the steaming pot on the dining table. The girl reacts with excitement. They both sit and eat the squid noodle soup with chopsticks and spoons. (13) The man stands in the kitchen holding a clipboard with papers. He stretches his arms and shoulders while talking to the camera. (14) The man performs various kettlebell exercises including overhead presses and rows, followed by dynamic planks and mountain climbers on the floor. He shows signs of physical exertion and fatigue. (15) Panning shots of the living room show three cats: one on a high shelf, one on a floor bed, and one walking across the room near a desk and air purifier. (16) A simple 2D animation shows a small man lying on the ground and a woman standing next to him on a yellow background.

(4) Background music swells slightly. Sound of rhythmic metal clicking on a wooden board (chopping onions). The man and girl exchange short, friendly phrases. (5) Auditory focus on running water from a kitchen tap, followed by a wet, sliding sound as a bone is removed from the squid. (6) Distinct sounds of a gas stove igniting (repetitive clicking) followed by the sizzle of oil and vegetables hitting a hot pot. Liquid pouring sound (rice wine and water). (7) Continuous bubbling and boiling sounds of soup. Metallic clinking of tongs against a ceramic pot and bowl. (8) Slurping sounds and the clatter of chopsticks against porcelain bowls. The girl lets out a loud 'Wow' and giggles. (9) The man's voice becomes slightly more strained and breathless. Paper rustling sound (clipboard). (10) Heavy rhythmic breathing and grunting sounds accompany the dull metallic 'thud' of a kettlebell hitting the floor. (11) Sound of fabric rustling and quick hand-slaps on a floor during a plank. The man exhales sharply. (12) Ambient hum of an air purifier. Faint background meow. The upbeat music fades out smoothly.
